=== registers by name
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	addi sp, sp, -32
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 32
	sw ra, 24(sp)
	sw s0, 16(sp)
	.cfi_offset ra, -8
	.cfi_offset s0, -16
	addi s0, sp, 32
	.cfi_def_cfa fp, 0
	.cfi_offset x9, -24
	.cfi_offset fs0, -32
	.cfi_offset f31, -40
	.cfi_offset a7, -48
	.cfi_offset t6, -56
	.cfi_register ra, t0
	.cfi_same_value zero
	.cfi_undefined gp
	.cfi_undefined tp
	lw ra, 24(sp)
	lw s0, 16(sp)
	.cfi_restore ra
	.cfi_restore s0
	addi sp, sp, 32
	.cfi_def_cfa sp, 0
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
=== compressed code
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	.cfi_startproc
	addi sp, sp, -16
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	li a0, 0
	.loc 1 5 1
	addi sp, sp, 16
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 0
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
